steps.title: Check Alerts
steps.description: Open the bell to review reminders, pain alerts, and plan updates.
steps.long_text: Notifications cover assessment prompts, plan changes, and adherence nudges.

fallback.message: Find notifications from the bell icon at the top right.

steps.title: Resume Session
steps.description: Tap to jump back into your guided exercise recording or start today’s routine.
steps.long_text: This button launches the recording flow with your next prescribed exercise.

fallback.message: Use the green Start / Resume button on the dashboard cards to record exercises.

steps.title: Begin Assessment
steps.description: Start your clinical assessment to tailor plans to your goals and symptoms.
steps.long_text: We guide you through goals, pain checks, history, and camera assessments.

fallback.message: Use the large gradient button at the bottom to progress through the assessment.

steps.title: Switch Camera
steps.description: Swap between front and rear cameras without leaving the recording session.

fallback.message: Use the camera switch icon near the preview to toggle viewpoints.

steps.title: Pause & Rest
steps.description: Pause recording to log partial progress and review instructions.

fallback.message: Pause via the red Pause button in the bottom control bar.

steps.title: Finish & Save
steps.description: Complete the set to review cooldown guidance and save metrics.

fallback.message: Tap the green Proceed or Finish button at the bottom to move on.

steps.title: Export Reports
steps.description: Generate a PDF summary with pain charts and adherence stats for your clinician.

fallback.message: Scroll to the Export Reports card and tap Export PDF Report.

steps.title: Sign In Securely
steps.description: Authenticate with your email to sync rehab plans and progress.

fallback.message: Sign in via the primary gradient button.

steps.title: Preview as Guest
steps.description: Explore core flows without creating an account. Data stays on-device.

fallback.message: Use Continue as Guest below the sign-in form.

steps.title: Create Account
steps.description: Need full tracking? Open registration to set up your secure profile.

fallback.message: Tap Create Account under the guest button to register.

steps.title: Sign Out Safely
steps.description: Use Logout to end your session and protect medical data.
steps.long_text: We automatically sync progress before signing out so you can resume later.

fallback.message: Use the Logout tile in Profile > Account & Security.
